display_name: LoRa W24 回写幅相细化与直角坐标对照（Full）
description: Freeze the source backbone. Compare equal-size Cartesian and polar narrow-band post-MAP refiners at fixed edit energy.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full and native_residual_w24_v1 practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Strictly load and freeze identical source-only 40000-step outer-loss W24 backbone. Both output heads use the same seed and zero last layer.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only
Strict 40000-step source-only initialization to both arms. Proof verified in fit.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native W24 matched source fit proof, exact reader F/complete.json binding, fixed blind control archive
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed-iteration source-only parent on same U_s cache with hidden TX and zero F, V, practical, trace or target reads. Chosen by source evidence only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at update 1200. Candidate half exceeds direct, matched half, original all-half and outer parent half on six scenes, meets all four on low urban and meets direct on clean. Eligible candidates run Full formal three shards, fixed predictions and independent truth-last.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 GPU preference 6, 7, 2, 0, 3; two eligible cards, one fit per GPU, at least 12 GiB free and under eight compute contexts.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, invalid gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or formal prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --band-refine after the three formal Full shards freeze.

rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 40000 fixed parent updates, then 1200 AdamW updates, batch 16. Only the small band head trains.

notes: Same observed complex IQ, carrier coherence, same fixed DURA edit, Conv1d shape and pretrained source backbone in both branches. Only complex parameterization differs.
Apply after the second MAP stage to both 9–32 kHz sidebands of the fixed DURA correction. Match the parent's per-packet band edit energy in physical IQ, preserving other bins and native edges.

Keep the stage losses and add the same 0.25 output correction term in both arms, evaluated as coefficient-wise relative complex error with a power floor against the equal-energy paired source edit. Only two perturbed observations enter the extra loss.

Training and freeze from source U only. No exact practical noise, W24, V, TX or target in fit. E104 on source panel only after freeze. Full-only three-shard official path after the fixed promotion gate.
